The `FETCH_CRD_AVAILABILITY_INFO` command can be used to determine available session types on the device. * `REBOOT`: Payload is a stringified JSON object in the form: { "user_session_delay_seconds": 300 }. The `user_session_delay_seconds` is the amount of seconds to wait before rebooting the device if a user is logged in. It has to be an integer in the range [0,300]. When payload is not present for reboot, 0 delay is the default. Note: This only applies if an actual user is logged in, including a Guest.
